### God's Sovereign Plan (Isaiah 14:24) - Your Daily Bible Verse - June 15
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-june-15.html
Passage: Isaiah 14:24
Points:
- The historical fulfillment of Isaiah's prophecies demonstrates that God's plans are completely dependable.
- God is actively involved in earthly affairs rather than leaving history to random chance.
- Even seemingly invincible empires like Assyria and Babylon could not resist the Lord's decreed purposes.
- Believers facing daunting circumstances can take comfort in the sovereign God whose good intentions for them will stand.
